title.narrative: Stöd till decentralisering och hållbar lokal utveckling i Georgien
Support to Decentralization and Sustainable Local Development in Georgia

description.narrative:
Based on theory of change the contribution overall objective defined as: Promote democratic, effective, and accountable local self-governments and sustainable local development in Georgia.
The specific objectives are:
1.Contributing to building capacity in municipalities to implement delegated tasks using participatory approaches.
2.Contributing to inclusive and evidence-based decentralization reform in Georgia.
3.Advocating decentralization reform and strengthening multi-level governance on local development.
Outcome of the first specific objective should be:
• Georgian municipalities have knowledge and institutional capacity to implement delegated tasks related to urban planning and development.
• Stronger representative democracy on local level.
• Georgian municipalities use modern approaches and tools for good governance and sustainable development.
Outcome of the second specific objective should be:
• Central authorities have institutional capacity for effective management of decentralization reform.
• Agency for Spatial Planning and Urban Development of Georgia (SUDA) has capacity to monitor, coordinate and provide service to municipalities on urban planning and development.

Projektet kommer att ge stöd till kommuner, stärka deras kapacitet att fullgöra sina mandat och spela en grundläggande roll för demokratisk och hållbar utveckling i Georgien. Syftet är också att bidra till en evidensbaserad utformning av politiken och att stärka användningen av bästa praxis vid samråd mellan central och lokal nivå samt flernivåstyre. Det kommer att kopplas till kraven i Georgiens process för EU-anslutning, Köpenhamnskriterierna och genomförandet av Agenda 2030.

The project will provide support to municipalities, strengthen their capacities to fulfill their mandates and play a fundamental role in democratic and sustainable development in Georgia. It also will aim to contribute to evidence-based policy formulation, and to strengthening the use of best practice in central-local consultations and multi-level governance. It will be linked to requirements in Georgia's process of EU-accession, the Copenhagen Criteria and the implementation of Agenda 2030.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative: The reporting period from May 2024 to April 2025 was one of major transition and adjustment. Although the project could not proceed as planned, SALAR International focused on keeping its networks active, protecting the knowledge and structures already built, and preparing a revised plan for future cooperation. The lessons learned during this time will serve as an important foundation for the next phase of the project if conditions allow its implementation.
